Name: Wyrd's Seasonal Silos (CP)
Author: logwyrd
Description:
[center]﻿Replaces the vanilla Silo building to include seasonal and height variants. Winter texture now matches Marnie's Silo![/center]

INSTRUCTIONS TO CHANGE HEIGHT:

[b]If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed:[/b]
Click on "Wyrd's Seasonal Silos", and set Height to tall or short.

[b]If you do not have Generic Mod Config Menu:
[/b]1. Download this mod.
2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder.
3. Open this mod's folder and click on config.json
4. Change "Height" : "short" to "tall".
5. Save, and restart your game.

[center][b]Enjoy!
[/b][b]
